== Summary ==
Slip “•Hoth: Main Power Generators (DARK)” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (85, 1533, 772, 2081)). Version [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (Dark)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
